Actress Shagufta Ali Praises Govinda's Perfectionism Over Aamir Khan

Actress Shagufta Ali has stated that her "Hero No. 1" co-star Govinda is a greater perfectionist than actor Aamir Khan. Ali elaborated that Govinda undertakes approximately 25 rehearsals for his scenes. She made these remarks in comparison to Khan's reputed meticulous approach to his craft.
